instruction:
You are a wastewater process engineer checking a task-owned synthetic SSC-10 biogas, sludge, and generator dispatch package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. Sludge production, digester gas metering, generator data sheet, load profile, and dispatch-policy workflows shape the context only; this instance does not parse a real process model, gas meter export, or accepted project report.

## Scene

- Product: `SSC-10-LH-07`
- Sludge production table: `SLUDGE-10-PROD-07`
- Digester/gas meter data: `DIGESTER-10-GAS-07`
- Generator data sheet: `GEN-10-DATA-07`
- Load profile: `LOAD-10-PROFILE-07`
- Operating policy: `POLICY-10-DISPATCH-07`
- Dispatch memo: `MEMO-10-DISPATCH-07`

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Sludge production | {{ sludge_production_kg_d }} kg/d |
| Volatile solids fraction | {{ volatile_solids_fraction }} |
| Volatile solids destruction | {{ volatile_solids_destruction_fraction }} |
| Biogas yield | {{ biogas_yield_m3_kg_vs }} m3/kg VS |
| Methane fraction | {{ methane_fraction }} |
| Methane energy | {{ methane_energy_kwh_m3 }} kWh/m3 |
| Generator electrical efficiency | {{ generator_electrical_efficiency }} |
| Generator rating | {{ generator_rated_kw }} kW |
| Critical process load | {{ critical_process_load_kw }} kW |
| Dispatch runtime | {{ dispatch_runtime_h }} h |
| Parasitic load | {{ parasitic_load_kw }} kW |
| Heat recovery efficiency | {{ heat_recovery_efficiency }} |
| Heat load to offset | {{ heat_load_kwh_d }} kWh/d |

## Calculation Rules

- Volatile solids feed equals sludge production times volatile solids fraction.
- Volatile solids destroyed equals volatile solids feed times destruction fraction.
- Biogas volume equals volatile solids destroyed times biogas yield.
- Methane energy equals methane volume times methane energy content.
- Generator electric energy equals methane energy times generator electrical efficiency.
- Available runtime equals generator electric energy divided by critical plus parasitic load.
- Overall pass score is `1.0` only when generator capacity, dispatch energy, and heat recovery margins are non-negative.

## Output Format

Write a compact memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Preserve the source IDs above and state whether the baseline source pack passes the current docs-only checks.

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated modelling evidence, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "volatile_solids_feed_kg_d": <numeric_value>,
  "volatile_solids_destroyed_kg_d": <numeric_value>,
  "biogas_m3_d": <numeric_value>,
  "methane_m3_d": <numeric_value>,
  "methane_energy_kwh_d": <numeric_value>,
  "generator_electric_energy_kwh_d": <numeric_value>,
  "average_generator_kw": <numeric_value>,
  "generator_capacity_margin_kw": <numeric_value>,
  "critical_dispatch_energy_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "dispatch_energy_margin_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "available_runtime_hr": <numeric_value>,
  "heat_recovery_kwh_d": <numeric_value>,
  "heat_recovery_margin_kwh_d": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```

# ABOUTME: Defines the SSC-10 biogas, sludge, and generator dispatch template.
# ABOUTME: Pins one sludge, digester, generator, load, dispatch policy, and memo source pack.

[meta]
name = "biogas-sludge-generator-dispatch-package"
description = "SSC-10 biogas, sludge, and generator dispatch metrics"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound biogas generator dispatch metrics from a deterministic SSC-10 task-owned source pack. The template combines volatile solids destruction, biogas and methane energy, generator electric energy, dispatch runtime, heat recovery, and an overall synthetic pass score."
discipline = "mechanical"
category = "biogas-generator-dispatch"
standards = ["sludge production workflow", "biogas production workflow", "generator dispatch workflow"]
tags = ["mechanical", "wastewater", "sludge", "biogas", "methane", "generator", "dispatch", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.sludge_production_kg_d]
type = "float"
unit = "kg/d"
description = "SLUDGE-10-PROD-07 sludge production"
min = 1180.0
max = 1180.0

[params.volatile_solids_fraction]
type = "float"
description = "SLUDGE-10-PROD-07 volatile solids fraction"
min = 0.74
max = 0.74

[params.volatile_solids_destruction_fraction]
type = "float"
description = "DIGESTER-10-GAS-07 volatile solids destruction fraction"
min = 0.52
max = 0.52

[params.biogas_yield_m3_kg_vs]
type = "float"
unit = "m3/kg VS"
description = "DIGESTER-10-GAS-07 biogas yield"
min = 0.92
max = 0.92

[params.methane_fraction]
type = "float"
description = "DIGESTER-10-GAS-07 methane fraction"
min = 0.63
max = 0.63

[params.methane_energy_kwh_m3]
type = "float"
unit = "kWh/m3"
description = "DIGESTER-10-GAS-07 methane energy content"
min = 9.97
max = 9.97

[params.generator_electrical_efficiency]
type = "float"
description = "GEN-10-DATA-07 generator electrical efficiency"
min = 0.36
max = 0.36

[params.generator_rated_kw]
type = "float"
unit = "kW"
description = "GEN-10-DATA-07 generator rating"
min = 180.0
max = 180.0

[params.critical_process_load_kw]
type = "float"
unit = "kW"
description = "LOAD-10-PROFILE-07 critical process load"
min = 86.0
max = 86.0

[params.dispatch_runtime_h]
type = "float"
unit = "h"
description = "POLICY-10-DISPATCH-07 required dispatch runtime"
min = 8.0
max = 8.0

[params.parasitic_load_kw]
type = "float"
unit = "kW"
description = "LOAD-10-PROFILE-07 parasitic generator plant load"
min = 12.0
max = 12.0

[params.heat_recovery_efficiency]
type = "float"
description = "GEN-10-DATA-07 heat recovery efficiency"
min = 0.44
max = 0.44

[params.heat_load_kwh_d]
type = "float"
unit = "kWh/d"
description = "LOAD-10-PROFILE-07 heat load to offset"
min = 1050.0
max = 1050.0

[outputs.volatile_solids_feed_kg_d]
description = "Volatile solids feed"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.volatile_solids_destroyed_kg_d]
description = "Volatile solids destroyed"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.biogas_m3_d]
description = "Daily biogas production"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.methane_m3_d]
description = "Daily methane production"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.methane_energy_kwh_d]
description = "Daily methane energy"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.generator_electric_energy_kwh_d]
description = "Daily generator electric energy"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.average_generator_kw]
description = "Average generator power over day"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.generator_capacity_margin_kw]
description = "Generator rating minus critical and parasitic load"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.critical_dispatch_energy_kwh]
description = "Critical dispatch energy"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.dispatch_energy_margin_kwh]
description = "Generator electric energy minus critical dispatch energy"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.available_runtime_hr]
description = "Available runtime at critical plus parasitic load"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.heat_recovery_kwh_d]
description = "Daily heat recovery"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.heat_recovery_margin_kwh_d]
description = "Recovered heat minus heat load"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "1.0 when generator capacity, dispatch energy, and heat recovery margins are non-negative"
tolerance = 0.001

[archetypes.ssc10_biogas_generator_dispatch_case]
description = "Biogas, sludge, and generator dispatch source pack"
site_contexts = ["biogas-generator-dispatch", "sludge-gas-dispatch-check"]

[archetypes.ssc10_biogas_generator_dispatch_case.params]
sludge_production_kg_d = {min = 1180.0, max = 1180.0}
volatile_solids_fraction = {min = 0.74, max = 0.74}

methane_fraction = {min = 0.63, max = 0.63}
methane_energy_kwh_m3 = {min = 9.97, max = 9.97}
generator_electrical_efficiency = {min = 0.36, max = 0.36}
generator_rated_kw = {min = 180.0, max = 180.0}
